title: Štip fire, July 2024
summary: EFFIS maps 13,335 ha burned in Štip and dates the fire from 2024-07-14 to 2024-07-18.
Satellites recorded 966 hotspot detections inside the mapped area on 17 of the 20 days shown, the most on 2024-07-15 (131).
The windiest day in ERA5 was 2024-07-30, averaging 12 km/h from the north with gusts to 46 km/h.

context.text: On the night of 13 July 2024 North Macedonia's parliament declared a 30-day nationwide crisis situation because of the rising number of wildfires in the central and eastern parts of the country.

selection: Archive detections (MODIS and VIIRS, algorithm type 2 static sources excluded) inside the EFFIS perimeter buffered by 1.5 km, from two days before the EFFIS fire date to one day after the last detection day of the fire's run (at most 2 empty days in between), 20 days at most 21.

weather.source: ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo archive API
weather.notes: Hourly values at the ERA5 cell nearest the perimeter centroid (about 25 km grid): regional weather, not the fire's own valley. Noon = 11:00 UTC; noon rain is the 24 h total up to that hour.
